meta.title: Model picker
meta.description: Takes over the composer's model button, so one click opens a collapsible, searchable model picker. When a profile has many providers and a hundred models the built-in menu lays every row out flat; this plugin groups models by provider, folds each group, and matches model names, model ids and provider names from one search field (several words are ANDed, whole-phrase hits rank first). The panel footer switches the current model's reasoning effort, and below it sit the session options other plugins inject (the Agent Teams switch, for example). Selection goes through the same shared modelDirectories service, so the /model popup and this panel always agree. Provider badges (credit and promotion labels) and other plugins' session options are relayed from the public registry, so nothing is dropped; each relayed component has its own error boundary, so one broken plugin cannot blank the panel. Keyboard: arrows move the highlight, Enter selects, Escape closes, Tab stays inside. IME composition is respected. No configuration fields. To restore the built-in menu, delete the conversation.input.model registration inside apply().
